selection: Fixed SHA256 domain and group index selects 200 of 2253 previously consumed training groups without reference to label, logits or holdout outcomes.
budget: One synthetic Job membership probe then one immutable cache snapshot and at most 400 CPU forward calls across two frozen models; at most 120000 selected candidate rows counted for both models.
metrics: Teacher top-1 agreement and teacher rank for each model and teacher operation, plus paired both/new-only/old-only/neither counts; zero-sample rates are unknown.
boundary: Training sample only; the new model saw these groups, the old model may not have. No causal, independent holdout, significance or promotion claim; no training or new game.
failure_policy: One attempt; identity, budget, membership, cleanup or inference failure stops without resampling or retry.
